legacyPreview.measurement: Raster visibility is disabled while measuring relink, so map tile requests do not contaminate validation reads. Source byte read-ahead is reported separately from decoded raster windows.

cases: real mean/ovr6 legacy TIFF relinks with bounded reads and preserves preview
serialized descriptor from legacy success reopens through header-only modern relink
native pixels and native profile section retain exact Float32 values
wrong TIFF with same dimensions extent and bytes is rejected without mutation
real mean/ovr3 legacy TIFF preserves non-square preview geometry and NoData
app Cancel during legacy sample verification preserves every layer
generation change while reading legacy samples discards stale selection
opening another real CCMGIS discards a pending legacy relink
editing preview cells during legacy verification retains the edit
authorized BN CCMGIS opens with full saved inventory
wrong real TIFF is rejected with BN vectors rasters groups stack and ortho unchanged

legacyVerificationLimits.workingEstimate: 3 * decoded bytes + 2 * compressed bytes + output bytes

mobileMemoryLimits.mobileReadRule: native window + optional resampled output + 3 * intersected decoded blocks + 2 * intersected compressed blocks; supported sequential sampling uses its bounded output planes and 3 * maximum decoded block + 2 * maximum compressed block
mobileMemoryLimits.mobileRangeRule: sum of declared lengths before any range allocation; global across concurrent fetch calls; held until every sibling range settles
mobileMemoryLimits.mobileConcurrencyRule: sum of estimated jobs never exceeds min(configured read budget, 32 MiB); lowering budget rejects queued jobs which no longer fit
mobileMemoryLimits.mobileDetection: Android/iPhone/iPad/iPod or Macintosh/Mac platform with more than one touch point
mobileMemoryLimits.desktop: No new hard caps. Existing desktop scheduling behavior retained.
mobileMemoryLimits.resolution: No resolution changes or reduced-resolution fallback introduced.

limitations: The reported iPad page reload was not reproduced on a physical device; memory pressure is a possible cause, not a confirmed diagnosis.
Correct-file browser tests use real synthetic TIFFs with overviews. The BN project was tested with an incompatible selection only.
The original 1,802,430,636-byte MDT could not be downloaded through the connector, whose per-file limit is 268,435,456 bytes.
Legacy content verification samples values and NoData in the saved mean overview; it does not read every original native cell.
Unsupported or oversized TIFF blocks are refused without changing the project. Budgets are conservative estimates for controlled allocations, not a cap on total browser RAM.
This change does not enable automatic project saving or automatic session recovery.
